forecasts.question: Will Netanyahu's coalition lose its Knesset majority or dissolve early before 2026-10-27?
forecasts.delta_reason: RESOLVE-YES. Multiple TIER1 sources confirm the coalition fell below 61 seats during the Haredi conscription crisis. J-Post reported 'Netanyahu's coalition falls to 48 seats.' Times of Israel confirmed the Knesset formally voted to disperse itself ahead of the Oct 27 election, with Netanyahu remaining as caretaker PM. Per the ambiguity rule: coalition dropped below 61 AND Netanyahu remains caretaker PM until election = YES. This forecast was phantom-active approximately 83 days after the YES condition was met; system catching up 2026-10-08. Retroactive resolution date approximately 2026-07-17 pending human confirmation (FLAG-3).
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if a Knesset roll-call vote confirms coalition loss of majority (61 seats), OR if Netanyahu announces early dissolution and election date moves earlier than 2026-10-27. NO if coalition survives to mandatory election date with 61+ seats intact.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: Knesset official record + Reuters/Haaretz/Times of Israel. Polling alone does not resolve.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: If coalition drops below 61 but Netanyahu remains caretaker PM until election: YES. If a single party departs but coalition retains 61+: NO. Reviewed weekly only (Sundays); no intra-week deltas.

forecasts.question: Will Iran publicly commit to resuming mediated ceasefire negotiations (a named Iranian official or MFA announces readiness for talks) before EOD 2026-09-06?
forecasts.delta_reason: RESOLVE-NO. The only qualifying statement in the Sep 3–6 window was President Pezeshkian's Sep 1 formulation that Iran was 'ready to return to the ceasefire agreement if the US does.' Per the ambiguity rule, conditional offers ('will talk if US stops strikes') resolve as NO unless the US publicly accepts the condition. The US did not publicly accept; CENTCOM strikes on Iran resumed Sep 1. No named Iranian official issued an unconditional public statement committing to resumed mediated ceasefire negotiations before EOD Sep 6.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if, before EOD 2026-09-06, a named Iranian official (FM Araghchi, SNSC, or IRNA/Tasnim quoting an official) issues a public statement committing to resuming or entering mediated ceasefire negotiations with the United States.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: One TIER1 (Reuters/AP/AFP/Al Jazeera) citing the named Iranian official, OR Iranian state media (IRNA/Tasnim) carrying the official statement.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Conditional or preconditioned offers ('will talk if US stops strikes') = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO unless the US publicly accepts the condition; a mediator asserting Iran is 'open' without a named Iranian official statement = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO.

Trump assertions of 'semi-negotiating' without Iranian or mediator confirmation = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO.

forecasts.question: Will commercial shipping through the Strait of Hormuz reach >=30 vessels/day (7-day rolling average) before EOD 2026-10-03?
forecasts.delta_reason: RESOLVE-NO (HIGH CONFIDENCE). IMF PortWatch satellite AIS placed the 7-day rolling average at approximately 3 commercial transits per day as of Oct 1, against a pre-crisis baseline of ~85/day. Windward's more generous AIS count reached 13 transits on Oct 4 — less than half the 30-vessel threshold. Peak observed was approximately 20-24 vessels Sep 26-28, still 25-30% below threshold. IRGC selective-passage toll system (~$2M per authorized vessel) drove Kpler's oil-volume recovery to ~80% of pre-war barrels but did not translate to vessel count. UKMTO reported at least one attack per day throughout September. The 30-vessel/day threshold was never approached.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if any AIS-based ship-tracking source (IMF PortWatch, Straits.live, MarineTraffic, Lloyd's List Intelligence) records >=30 commercial transits/day as a 7-day rolling average at any point between 2026-09-03 and 2026-10-03.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: AIS-based tracker + one TIER1 or OSINT confirmation (Bloomberg/Reuters/Lloyd's List).
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Naval escort vessels and warships do not count toward commercial transit. Where Windward and PortWatch diverge by >5 vessels/day, use the lower figure. AIS-dark vessels unaddressed; if AIS-dark count would push total above threshold, flag AMBIGUOUS.

forecasts.question: Will Likud win the most Knesset seats (seat plurality) in the October 27, 2026 Israeli election?
forecasts.delta_reason: UPDATE 0.42→0.36. Rolling average of 10 polls published Sep 28–Oct 6 places Yashar (Eisenkot) at 23.6 seats against Likud's 21.8 (israel2026.co.il tracker). Oct 5 standalone poll: Yashar 23, Likud 21. Kan poll: blocs tied 52-51, Yashar 23, Likud 21. Channel 13: Yashar 22, Likud 18. ToI tracker: tied 21 each. i24NEWS outlier: Likud 27, Yashar 22 (lone poll showing Likud ahead). Polymarket snapshot (Sep 22): Yashar ~62%, Likud ~39% for winning most seats. Four of five major polls sampled Oct 5-8 show Yashar ahead. Tie scenarios (~15% of polling scenarios) now explicitly assigned to NO under amended tie-handling clause. DA opposing narrative accepted: consistent Yashar polling direction warrants downward adjustment.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if official Knesset election results published by the Israeli Central Elections Committee (CEC) show Likud winning more seats than any other single party in the October 27, 2026 election. EXIT POLL CLAUSE: If three or more major Israeli broadcast networks (Channel 12, Channel 13, Kan) publish exit polls with consistent direction showing Likud plurality EOD Oct 27, this triggers a provisional YES pending CEC certification. TIE-HANDLING: Likud and any other party receiving identical certified seat totals resolves as NO — a tie is not a plurality.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: Israeli Central Elections Committee official results, carried by Times of Israel/Haaretz/Reuters/AP. Exit poll consensus of 3+ networks may trigger provisional YES pending certification.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: If Likud and any other party tie on certified seat totals: NO — a tie is not a plurality. If CEC certification is delayed beyond EOD Nov 5 due to legal challenges: AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO pending certification. Exit poll consensus of 3+ networks in consistent direction triggers provisional YES; provisional converts to final on CEC certification or reversal.

forecasts.question: Will the US and Iran reach a signed written ceasefire or formal stoppage-of-hostilities agreement before EOD 2026-11-05?

Ghalibaf (Oct 4) stated seven preconditions must be met before Hormuz reopens with sequencing opposite to US demands. Pezeshkian characterized US negotiations as 'meaningless.' However, Iran demonstrated willingness to sign under pressure (April/June 2026 precedents) and both sides have midterm-adjacent incentives. Confirmed UNGA sidelines session Sep 22-23 shows channel is open despite rhetoric. P=0.17 weights structural obstacles against demonstrated last-minute-signing behavior.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if TIER1 reporting confirms a written ceasefire or formal stoppage-of-hostilities agreement bearing signatures of named senior representatives of both US government and Iranian government, with fixed start date, published between 2026-10-08 and 2026-11-05.

Partial Hormuz reopening agreement not covering hostilities = NO for this forecast. Conditional agreement pending ratification with no force yet = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO.

forecasts.question: Will US CENTCOM conduct confirmed airstrikes or missile strikes on targets inside internationally recognized Iranian sovereign territory before EOD 2026-10-31?
forecasts.delta_reason: New 23-day forecast seeded Oct 8. Axios (~Oct 3) reported Pentagon directed CENTCOM to complete strike preparations with no execution date and no final presidential authorization — preparation order confirmed OBSERVED per Axios, pending second-source verification (FLAG-2). Trump described the decision as 'easy way or hard way' and characterized it as imminent. Vance (Oct 7) reiterated Iran cannot have nuclear weapons. Against this: Trump withheld authorization in at least two prior comparable windows; ceasefire deal (F9, p=0.17) possible before Oct 31; midterm political calculation may favor threat over action. P=0.38 weights confirmed preparation order and rhetorical escalation against established authorization-withholding pattern.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if CENTCOM issues official statement confirming US airstrikes or missile strikes on targets inside internationally recognized borders of Iran, with confirmed strikes occurring between 2026-10-08 and 2026-10-31. OR two independent TIER1 sources with named US DoD sources confirm strikes on Iranian territory in that window.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: CENTCOM official statement on centcom.mil OR two independent TIER1 sources with named US Defense Department officials (not anonymous backgrounders). Pentagon press briefing on-record statements count.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Strikes on IRGC-backed proxy forces outside Iranian territory = NO. US strikes on Iranian naval vessels at sea = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO unless CENTCOM explicitly characterizes them as strikes on Iranian sovereign territory. DoD off-record anonymous backgrounders without on-record confirmation = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO.
